name: slapstick-english-translation
description: An English translation of the Super Famicom title "Slapstick"

scripts.build:rom: npm run check && node tools/build-patch.mjs --rom-output "build/Slap Stick (Japan) [EN].sfc"
scripts.check: node tools/reflow-dialog.mjs --check && node tools/validate-script.mjs && node tools/build-patch.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:harness && npm run test:icons && npm run test:reflow && npm run test:scenario
